The '''Marauder Mountain''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It was bordered by the [[Mertuen Forest]] to the north and east.<ref name="SWG" /> The mountain was named after the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] who had their [[Marauder's Stronghold|stronghold]] in the area.<ref name="SWG:MS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Marauder Mountain was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
